body:
@bruvzg it seems like deadlocks appear in two distinct patterns (one with `SceneShaderForwardClustered::singleton_mutex` and the other with `BaseMaterial3D::material_mutex`).

Can you recall which one you tested your diff against ?

> Can you recall which one you tested your diff against ?

If you work around `material_mutex` with the patch, it's locking in `singleton_mutex`. But without the patch, it's almost always locking in `singleton_mutex` as well. And I got a few crashes with material related errors while testing the patch.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/103506 seems to solve both (at least for me, I have run it 50 times with cleaned shader cache, and did not get a single deadlock).
